alternative_explanations: Stable relation clustering may only regularize local ridge or may collapse to a mixture of linear experts already covered by classical controls.
confounds: The three native families have different valid widths; any width or mask routing invalidates rather than supporting transfer.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate if any candidate receives a family label, source path, native type or semantic channel name.
Invalidate if normalization reads a holdout output or any value outside assigned slow-fit worlds.
Invalidate if a history, support or forecast window crosses a whole-world or DS08a cycle boundary.
Invalidate if shared, independent, cross-family-only or support-only changes learner source or hyperparameters.
Invalidate if any invariant-module role reads World.slot or uses a tensor mask signature, valid width or family-identifying shape as a routing key.

Invalidate unless all six causal roles share relation extraction, module representation, fit order, prediction, update, constants and accounting, differing only in assigned training scope, disabled environment-stability selection or frozen partition.
Invalidate if masked loss is not averaged within world and equally across the three evaluator-private families.
Invalidate if acquisition, normalization, fit, adaptation, query, update, bytes, state or R1/R4/R16 cost is omitted.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, scoring-seed leakage, external model/API use or evaluator-integrity change.

falsification_criteria: Discard on any frozen per-family quality margin, causal-gain, stability, worst-family, accounting, state or Pareto failure; invalidate on slot access, mask/family routing, leakage, source mismatch, post-score tuning, seed leakage, external model/API, preflight or integrity failure.

outcome_policy.negative: End this exact signature, radius, cap, stability gate, four-relation ridge and clipping rule without tuning or replication.
outcome_policy.null: If stability beats nulls but not classical controls at full cost, preserve the causal diagnostic and falsify the capability-cost conjunction.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep only as one-seed scout evidence and preregister an unchanged three-seed adversarial replication.
